verdict.rationale: Featurebase explicitly documents a full HTTP and SDK API reference plus webhooks for reacting to feedback/status changes, and its developer docs site is crawlable via llms.txt listing SDK guides, indicating a genuine documented public API surface for programmatic/AI-driven use. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe returned 404s at standard paths) and independent third-party confirmation of API completeness/reliability.
